zh: 您确认一下，我们的课是几点开始？
old_en: Could you check if our class starts at eight o'clock?
new_en: Could you confirm what time our class starts?

zh: 请问您现在方便吗？我们这节课是八点钟。
old_en: Are you available now? Our class is at eight o'clock.
new_en: Are you free now? Our class is at eight o'clock.

zh: 这节课我们要学习哪些内容呢？
old_en: What content will we be covering in this class?
new_en: What will we learn in this class?

zh: 接下来我们会讲到哪些进度？
old_en: What topics will we cover next?
new_en: What progress will we make next?

zh: 这周的作业是读第几章呢？
old_en: This week's homework is to read chapter three, do you know which one?
new_en: Which chapter is the homework for this week?

zh: 这周的作业是写一篇作文，您准备好了吗？
old_en: This week's homework is to write an essay, are you ready for it?
new_en: This week's homework is an essay. Are you ready?

zh: 上课时记得带课本和笔哦。
old_en: Remember to bring your textbook and pen to class, okay?
new_en: Remember to bring your textbook and pen to class.

zh: 请您带好笔记本和铅笔，这节课要用到。
old_en: Please bring your notebook and pencil, you'll need them for the class.
new_en: Please bring your notebook and pencil for this lesson.

zh: 我们班有二十个学生。
old_en: We have twenty students in our class.
new_en: There are twenty students in our class.

zh: 请假的话需要提前通知我。
old_en: You need to inform me in advance if you want to take leave.
new_en: Please let me know in advance if you need to take leave.

zh: 你孩子上课表现很好。
old_en: Your child behaved well in class.
new_en: Your child is doing very well in class.

zh: 最近你的孩子课堂上有些不专心。
old_en: Your child hasn't been very focused in class lately.
new_en: Your child has been a bit distracted in class lately.

zh: 可以在家练习拼音。
old_en: You can practice pinyin at home.
new_en: You can practice pinyin at home.

zh: 下周我们将安排一次测验，请做好准备。
old_en: Next week we will have a test, please prepare yourself.
new_en: We will have a test next week, so please prepare.

zh: 家长会定在下个月的第一个星期六，请您准时参加。
old_en: The parent meeting is set for the first Saturday of next month, please attend on time.
new_en: The parent meeting is on the first Saturday of next month. Please attend on time.

zh: 你的进步很大，继续保持哦。
old_en: Your progress is great, keep it up.
new_en: You have made great progress, so keep it up.

zh: 这学期你很努力，希望假期里也别忘了学习。
old_en: This semester you have worked hard, hope you don't forget to study during the holiday.
new_en: You worked hard this semester, but don't forget to study during the holiday.

zh: 这个班级总共有十五名同学。
old_en: There are fifteen classmates in total in this class, can I help you with anything?
new_en: There are fifteen students in total in this class.

zh: 学费是一学期一千元。
old_en: The tuition fee for one semester is one thousand yuan, do you need help with anything else?
new_en: The tuition fee is one thousand yuan per semester.

zh: 在家多读课文会有帮助。
old_en: I can help you read the text at home more often.
new_en: Reading the text more often at home will help.
